# Preserved upstream notices

These unmodified texts fill omissions in npm package archives. They do not change
upstream licensing. Recheck against the pinned version when updating dependencies.

- Vue devtools API 6.6.4: vuejs/vue-devtools commit
  dd2ab5d4275187cbd81952a2a3d53c335643c1f4, root LICENSE.
- Vuestic UI 1.10.3: epicmaxco/vuestic-ui commit
  9ba04aab42f9c6c6b35b4570333293c760b62786, root LICENSE.MD.
- Rolldown 1.1.8 native bindings: rolldown/rolldown commit
  7b3948a52a23d193513b81cf535a8d8c409827aa, THIRD-PARTY-LICENSE;
  the matching package's LICENSE is collected alongside this text.

Sources use https://github.com/ followed by the repository and commit above.
The notice generator collects these only for matching package versions.

Documentation package omissions:

- algolia/autocomplete 1.17.7: commit 8467b7a316ac6030f3e5cce6bdfdaf3068818d73, LICENSE.
- algolia/docsearch 3.8.2: commit a425f6f4e5714e9454ea172dc5ada5e4a0da27af, LICENSE.
- simple-icons/simple-icons 16.38.0 (Iconify package 1.2.103): commit
  74fa843c81f86d7fe28fe54b6f206efb3104af13, LICENSE.md.
- Native esbuild and Rollup packages inherit their matching parent package
  license texts collected from the same locked installation.
